title: Release history planned point
description: One file to measure, as the plan names it: written by `frontend/scripts/release-history.ts` (`plan`), read by `release_history/releases.py` (`Point.from_json`) in each measure job. A recorded build at one commit of the release repository. Version 1: every key listed here is required and no other key is allowed. A key added later is declared here with the version that added it, and is not required, so the documents already written stay valid and no format version moves.
